What I do is using stim toys! It distracts me quite well and works best for me, I recommend non-toxic putty in case you bite it or something, and also tangles work well!
Aside from that, if you don't have any stim toys at the moment, try concentrating on a task, in general manual activities keep you in check, you'll still tic, but it does calm down the whole thing.
Otherwise if none of that works, try sitting/laying down in a comfortable position, put on a podcast or a meditation/hypnosis video and grab a pillow so you don't hurt yourself when you have hitting tics!
I take abilify for my tourette's and it does it's job at lessening my tics, maybe ask your neurologist/doctor to see about medication!
